d:
Okay... The wait is over... It's time to release the new public story! And this time it's the return of our favorite rangers... Or not... Because this is a special chapter, as it narrates Silma's experience escaping the elven palace when everything began to collapse. You could say it's a Vamp Elf 3, where the important thing is that we'll meet Juliet, Silma's best friend who accompanied her until that fateful day... Without further ado, I hope you enjoy it!
